verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਮ ਨਿਰੁਦਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal kaam nihakaam keene gurmukh udham nirudham ukat hai ||

en.bdb: A disciple coming face to face of the Guru frees himself from all desires and wants by receiving the unique and comforting words of the True. Guru. Thus he frees himself from the worldly encumbrances with the strength of his meditation and consecration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਏ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag hui dhubidhaa bharam khoe charan saran gahe nihachal mat hai ||

en.bdb: Treading the path of Guru, he destroys all his duality and doubts. The refuge of the True Guru makes his mind stable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਤ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਿਤ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan parasat aasaa manasaa thakit sabadh surat giaan praan praanapat hai ||

en.bdb: By the glimpse of the True Guru, all his desires and sensualities get tired and become ineffective. Remembering the Lord with every breath, he becomes totally aware of the Lord, the master of our lives.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਬਸੇਰਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੨॥
verses.translit_en: rachanaa charitr chitr bisam bachitr pan chitr mai chiteraa ko baseraa sat sat hai ||282||

en.bdb: The multiform creations of the Lord are wondrous and astonishing. The Guru-oriented disciple realises the presence of the Lord in this whole picture as true and eternal. (282)
